dialogue.speech: So what? That's got nothing to do with me eliminating you.

dialogue.speech: Why do you say that?

dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.speech: In order to get rid of gangs that sell drugs to children,

dialogue.speech: Do you even know what that means?!

dialogue.speech: What a great view...

dialogue.speech: Yes. If I'm going to take over this city,

dialogue.speech: I'll have to join the organization that rules it and work my way up.
